hero_blocks_ends_after_starts.name: hero_blocks_ends_after_starts
hero_blocks_ends_after_starts.value: "hero_blocks"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "hero_blocks"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "hero_blocks"."ends_at" >= "hero_blocks"."starts_at"

memberships_ends_after_starts.name: memberships_ends_after_starts
memberships_ends_after_starts.value: "memberships"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "memberships"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "memberships"."ends_at" >= "memberships"."starts_at"

points_ledger_source_once_key.name: points_ledger_source_once_key
points_ledger_source_once_key.where: "points_ledger"."reason" NOT IN ('manual', 'reversal') AND "points_ledger"."source_id" IS NOT NULL

certificates_level_kind.name: certificates_level_kind
certificates_level_kind.value: ("certificates"."kind" = 'level') = ("certificates"."level" IS NOT NULL) AND "certificates"."level" IS DISTINCT FROM 'novice'

quiz_questions_options.name: quiz_questions_options
quiz_questions_options.value:
CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("quiz_questions"."options") = 'array'
				THEN jsonb_array_length("quiz_questions"."options") BETWEEN 2 AND 6
					AND "quiz_questions"."correct_index" >= 0 AND "quiz_questions"."correct_index" < jsonb_array_length("quiz_questions"."options")
				ELSE false END

quiz_attempts_result.name: quiz_attempts_result
quiz_attempts_result.value:
("quiz_attempts"."passed" IS NULL) = ("quiz_attempts"."correct_count" IS NULL)
				AND ("quiz_attempts"."passed" IS NULL) = ("quiz_attempts"."submitted_at" IS NULL)
				AND ("quiz_attempts"."passed" IS NULL OR ("quiz_attempts"."correct_count" BETWEEN 0 AND "quiz_attempts"."total"
					AND "quiz_attempts"."passed" = ("quiz_attempts"."correct_count" >= "quiz_attempts"."pass_count")))
